name: Forever Inside A Loop
hint: If two loops are nested and the inner loop is a forever loop, the inner loop will never terminate. Thus the statements preceeding the inner loop are only executed once.[newLine]The statements following the inner loop will never be executed. Try to create a second script for the forever loop.
